summary: Practise geological data validation, QGIS preparation and spatial alignment for mining exploration. Review the course outline and outcomes.
lede: GIS-based geological data validation helps exploration geologists, GIS practitioners and technical leads check location data and prepare spatial outputs for review. Practical work includes checking coordinate reference systems and sample-location tables, georeferencing map inputs, documenting QA/QC decisions, and reviewing feature alignment and map limitations in QGIS.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who prepare, check or use geological and spatial information in mineral exploration. It is designed for exploration geologists who need to verify location data and for GIS practitioners who prepare maps for technical review.
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
